description: This Java class defines a response object for the 'ModifyFeatureProperty' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates details such as the feature ID, property pointer, and property value for a feature modification response, with methods to create instances from JSON, and standard overrides for equality, hash, and string representation.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyResponse
classes.description: Immutable response class for 'ModifyFeatureProperty' command, encapsulating feature ID, property pointer, property value, and HTTP status, with functionality to parse from JSON and create specific response instances.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a response for a newly created feature property, with status code CREATED.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a response for a modified feature property, with status code NO_CONTENT.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeaturePropertyResponse instance from a JSON string or object, parsing relevant fields.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeaturePropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the feature property involved in the response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose property was modified.

methods.name: getFeaturePropertyValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the feature property value, if present.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the feature property value as JsonValue, SchemaVersion aware.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs the JSON pointer resource path for the modified feature property.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the object's data to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new response with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on fields and superclass.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on object fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the object including key fields.
